_about: Prior active models' own ablations of where to look: the model with its viewpoints chosen at random against the same model with its learned (or rule-based) choice, everything else equal. Each value read in the paper's table on 2026-10-01 (the arXiv PDF's text, by a Claude Code session). random: accuracy with random viewpoints; chosen: with the paper's own choice of viewpoints; both in %.

ablations.setting: ResNet-50, 5 glimpses of 96 px after a glance at the whole image
ablations.chosen_by: a policy learned by reinforcement learning
ablations.where: Table 1, t = 5 (Random Policy + Glance Step; GFNet)

ablations.setting: 8 glimpses of 32 px, all weights trained
